integrity: The lower bound uses complete exact-rational dual certificates for the finite polyhedral reduction, while the upper bound is witnessed by an explicit operator. No infinite theorem is inferred from finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the real Lipschitz-free space over the unit five-cycle \(C_5\); it does not claim a formula for other cycles, general graph metrics, or complex scalars.
title: Numerical index three quarters for the five-cycle Lipschitz-free space
